items.title: I made an AI that reviews iPhone apps – 1h of autonomous GUI work
items.raw_excerpt:
I've been building Understudy, an open-source GUI agent for macOS.
Wanted to push the GUI stuff beyond the usual short demos, so I tried turning it into an iPhone app reviewer. You give it one prompt. It browses the real App Store in Chrome, installs the app on a real iPhone through macOS iPhone Mirroring (not a simulator), opens the app and explores it — never seen Snapseed before — records clips and screenshots, composites a narrated review video with FFmpeg locally, uploads it to YouTube, then deletes the app. About an hour, didn't touch the keyboard. The exploration part is what I'm happiest with. The agent reads the App Store description, goes "they say background removal works, let me try that," and then figures out an unfamiliar app on its own. It regrounds from the live screenshot

title_i18n.en: I made an AI that reviews iPhone apps – 1h of autonomous GUI work
title_i18n.zh: 我开发了一款能审查iPhone应用的人工智能——可自主进行1小时的图形用户界面操作。
title_i18n.es: Creé una IA que revisa aplicaciones de iPhone: una hora de trabajo autónomo con interfaz gráfica.

excerpt_i18n.en:
I've been building Understudy, an open-source GUI agent for macOS.
Wanted to push the GUI stuff beyond the usual short demos, so I tried turning it into an iPhone app reviewer. You give it one prompt. It browses the real App Store in Chrome, installs the app on a real iPhone through macOS iPhone Mirroring (not a simulator), opens the app and explores it — never seen Snapseed before — records clips and screenshots, composites a narrated review video with FFmpeg locally, uploads it to YouTube, then deletes the app. About an hour, didn't touch the keyboard. The exploration part is what I'm happiest with. The agent reads the App Store description, goes "they say background removal works, let me try that," and then figures out an unfamiliar app on its own. It regrounds from the live screenshot
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我一直在开发Understudy，这是一款面向macOS的开源图形用户界面代理。我希望将图形界面功能从常见的简短演示中进一步拓展，因此尝试将其打造成一款iPhone应用评测工具。你只需提供一个指令，它便能浏览真实的
excerpt_i18n.es: He estado desarrollando Understudy, un agente GUI de código abierto para macOS. Quería llevar el tema de la interfaz gráfica más allá de las típicas demostraciones breves, así que intenté convertirlo en un revisor de aplicaciones para iPhone. Le das una única instrucción. title_i18n.zh: 非营利组织上线首个“AI 失业补助”：每月发 1000 美元，持续 1 年
title_i18n.en: A nonprofit organization has launched the first "AI unemployment benefit": providing $1,000 per month for one year.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 近日，有报道称，非营利组织 AI Commons Project 与 What We Will 联合推出首个针对 AI 冲击设计的“AI 红利（AI Dividend）”基本收入试验计划，旨在为受生成式 AI 影响而失业的劳工提供经济支持与职涯转型协助。
excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, reports indicate that the nonprofit organization AI Commons Project, in collaboration with What We Will, has launched the first "AI Dividend" basic income pilot program designed to address AI disruption. The initiative aims to provide economic support and career transition assistance to workers who have lost their jobs due to the impact of generative AI.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, se informó que la organización sin fines de lucro AI Commons Project, en colaboración con What We Will, ha lanzado el primer programa piloto de "Dividendo de IA" para un ingreso básico, diseñado específicamente para abordar el impacto de la IA. El objetivo es proporcionar apoyo económico y asistencia en la transición profesional a los trabajadores que han perdido sus empleos debido a la influencia de la IA generativa.

items.title: Introducing Amazon Polly Bidirectional Streaming: Real-time speech synthesis for conversational AI
items.raw_excerpt: Today, we’re excited to announce the new Bidirectional Streaming API for Amazon Polly, enabling streamlined real-time text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis where you can start sending text and receiving audio simultaneously. This new API is built for conversational AI applications that generate text or audio incrementally, like responses from large language models (LLMs), where users must begin synthesizing audio before the full text is available.

This new API is built for conversational AI applications that generate text or audio incrementally, like responses from large language models (LLMs), where users must begin synthesizing audio before the full text is available.
